name: Crystalline Giant
oracle_text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose a kind of counter at random that this creature doesn't have on it from among flying, first strike, deathtouch, hexproof, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, vigilance, and +1/+1. Put a counter of that kind on this creature.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of combat on your turn, choose a kind of counter at random that this creature doesn't have on it from among flying, first strike, deathtouch, hexproof, lifelink, menace, reach, trample, vigilance, and +1/+1. Put a counter of that kind on this creature.

needs.what: a random choice among a printed list of counter kinds, restricted at resolution to the kinds the source does not currently have a counter of, then add_counters of the chosen kind on the source (e.g. a choose_mode with random: true whose modes may carry an availability condition such as {not: {cmp counters_on self > 0}}, or an add_counters option `random_kind_from: [...]` with `exclude_present: true`)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: choose_mode has random: true but no per-mode availability condition; once_each strikes off modes already chosen, which diverges whenever a counter is removed or was placed by another source (and never re-offers a kind whose counter was lost); a random pick over all ten followed by an `if` that does nothing when the counter is present changes the distribution and can place nothing
